card.text: The secondary star of OGLE-LMC-ECL-10567, a pair that eclipse each other every 117.975 days.

introduction.text: It has 3.184 solar masses and 36.64 solar radii; its partner has 3.333 and 24.6, measured from the eclipses and the stars' motions.
